activity.notes: Attakullakulla was a leading Overhill Cherokee diplomat and civil leader, widely identified with the First Beloved Man role. He was not monarch of a unitary 'Cherokee Tribe' state, so ATLAS uses the historically specific Overhill Cherokee political community and avoids a sovereign-king interpretation.

sources.title: Attakullakulla — Tennessee Encyclopedia
sources.citation_text: The Tennessee Encyclopedia describes Attakullakulla as a powerful Overhill Cherokee leader and principal spokesman in the mid-eighteenth century, while distinguishing his authority from a unitary paramount kingship.
